dedupe_keys.name: postdata open data platform of colombia s communications regulation commission crc

description: Postdata is the open data platform of Colombia's Communications Regulation Commission (CRC), which gathers and analyses statistics on the ICT, postal and audiovisual sectors that operators must report under CRC Resolution 5050 of 2016. It offers datasets, reports, dashboards, short Data Flash bulletins and maps; its datasets are also federated to the national portal datos.gov.co, where 80 Postdata entries were listed when searched. Series include subscribers, revenue, traffic and speeds of fixed internet (accesses by technology, segment and municipality from 2010), mobile internet, mobile and fixed telephony, television and SMS; infrastructure and coverage of mobile access networks; quality indicators for fixed and mobile data and voice services and carrier service availability by municipality; internet traffic during COVID-19; complaints; roaming; number portability; tariffs; approved terminals; the San Andrés submarine cable monitoring; and postal services. Coverage: Colombia, many series by municipality and quarter. Format and access: CSV downloads with previews, dataset metadata in DCAT-AP and DCAT POD JSON or XML, dashboards and PDF reports, free; datasets state no specific licence. Caveats: operator-reported figures; formats and breakdowns change when reporting rules change. Simulation uses: demand, capacity and service quality inputs for Colombian telecom models, and municipal exposure of users to outages. Related records: the CRC mobile network infrastructure and coverage data and the San Andrés cable monitoring are single datasets from this platform, and the LAC-IX survey covers Colombian exchanges.
licence: Postdata terms of use: free access to public data without restriction (no named licence)
